hypothesis: Collapsing left/right texting/phone-call subclasses into PHONE_USE reduces subject-specific nuisance variation and improves subject-disjoint generic phone-event recall without exceeding the frozen false-positive budget.
promotion_gate: On gC-14/gZ-36 development benchmark, all of precision, recall and F1 must exceed 0.85 with at most 3 false positives; independent holdout remains mandatory for a final claim.
stop_rules: Do not tune thresholds after viewing either coarse-head result.
Reject recovery when false positives exceed 3.
Do not replace the D5 baseline when any primary metric regresses.
Do not use consumed holdouts gE-28 or gZ-37.
